02.description: Built during the colony rush, this enormous reactor-powered freighter has abundant floor space for hauling and two cabins that each comfortably sleep two. Given that the ship was designed to construct and expand structures throughout the System, it is ideal for long-duration travel and hauling.

02Indy.description: An independent operator refit of the Ryokka CR-43, a colony rush mainstay. This variant sacrifices one sleeping cabin for a medbay, and some cargo area for a rec room. Designed for hauling in comfort over long periods.

AirRacer.description: An aero racing chassis built in partnership with Mobile Space Systems. The Cobra serves as the platform for many competing teams' entries into aero racing leagues across the System.

Argute Rapid Courier.description: An extremely fast and highly nimble ship boasting a Miura intake regulator and two packages of ten thrusters on each wing. Originally built as a show model to demonstrate the strength of MSS ship frames, this rare build found a niche as a short range courier for time-critical, small-volume deliveries in torch-limited airspace.

Babak Refit.description:
A light combat ship built by cutting up comercially available Babak multipurpose transport and grafting an armored nose with spinal rail cannon and additional PDC and missile systems. 'Civilian' part of hull was further up-armored by bolting on external ablative cladding and 'cope-cage' framework.

Operated by a small ex-military veteran PMC, it briefly got into headlines after a daring raid on a prison ship heading to Prokofiev facility that freed several captured members of said PMC.

Babak.description:
A multipurpose transport ship in use by US navies, and manufactured by Langdon Philips.

The vessel is popular in the aftermarket due to its versatility and room for retrofittings.

Baleen.description: An aggressive-postured battleship from the Titan shipyards, boasting many of the latest contractor tech from Langdon-Phillips, Smartlink, et al.

Boomerang.description: This unusual airframe is one of Van Buren's most recent entries into the Venusian market. Its asymmetric design has proven to be highly divisive among consumers, which has only added to its demand from customers wanting to make a bold statement.

Bulk Lifter.description: Testudo's Bulk Lifters dot the System in long, slow Hohmann transfers, whiling away the long dark months in the hope of a tidy profit at the end.

CR-53b.description: An enormous reactor-powered freighter with abundant floor space. Built as an upgrade to the CR-43, the 53b was Ryokka's first collaboration with Mobile Space Systems, and features a lighter weight frame than its predecessor. Ideal for long-haul travel.

Coffin.description: A custom racer scratch built for illegal RCS circuit rallies. Maximized for speed and maneuverability, so all systems not relevant to these ends have been cut, including life-support. About as safe as the name implies.

CombatPod_Can.description: A salvage pod hastily retrofitted with dual mass throwers, for use as a fast strike and \"enemy harrassment\" vessel.

CombatPod_Mis.description: A salvage pod hastily retrofitted with a twin missile racks, for use as a strike bomber.

CombatPod_MisCan.description: A salvage pod hastily retrofitted with a PDC cannon and missile launcher, for use as a general purpose, light strike craft.

CombatPod_PDCCan.description: A salvage pod hastily retrofitted with a PDC cannon, for use as a mobile missile defense and "enemy harrassment" vessel.

Edelweiss.description: A large reactor powered freighter with zero frills. Some claim the Edelweiss was a cheaply thrown together imitation of the Ryokka CR-43, built to cash in on the colony rush and pushed into production as soon as Testudo's executives got their hands on Ryokka's early design concepts.

Firebat.description: A custom racer retrofitted with twin missile launchers and light armor, often seen in pirate flotillas.

Halberd DANGER.description: A reactor powered pleasure craft with a single cabin and twin linked Miura "Hydra" intake regulators. Built as a collaboration with Mobile Space Systems, half the ship has luxury "orange way" interiors, making the Halberd a highly sought after ship for solo spacers.

Halberd Empty.description: A reactor powered pleasure craft with a single cabin and twin linked Miura "Hydra" intake regulators. Built as a collaboration with Mobile Space Systems, half the ship has luxury "orange way" interiors, making the Halberd a highly sought after ship for solo spacers.

Halberd Off.description: A reactor powered pleasure craft with a single cabin and twin linked Miura "Hydra" intake regulators. Built as a collaboration with Mobile Space Systems, half the ship has luxury "orange way" interiors, making the Halberd a highly sought after ship for solo spacers.

Halberd.description: A reactor powered pleasure craft with a single cabin and twin linked Miura "Hydra" intake regulators. Built as a collaboration with Mobile Space Systems, half the ship has luxury "orange way" interiors, making the Halberd a highly sought after ship for solo spacers.

Hand Of God.description: It is said that god cannot kill what god cannot catch. Something upon which this shipwright was clearly willing to stake their life.

Heavy Tug 01.description: A reactor powered cabinless tug with a low end RCS package. Despite being an incredibly efficient design, the TU44-a is regarded as a bit of an ugly duckling given its non-standard layout.

HeavyTug02.description: A reactor powered cabinless tug with a low end RCS package. Despite being an incredibly efficient design, the TU44-a is regarded as a bit of an ugly duckling given its non-standard layout.

Ibex.description: This reactor powered long range survey and exploration vessel can house a small crew in relative comfort. Includes two adjacent air tight bays rated for science and engineering. Given the potentially volatile nature of the experiments done on the Ibex, the ship has additional redundancy in the form of two Nav stations in the standard design.

IbexCargo.description: This reactor powered long range survey and exploration vessel can house a small crew in relative comfort. Includes two adjacent air tight bays rated for science and engineering. Given the potentially volatile nature of the experiments done on the Ibex, the ship has additional redundancy in the form of two Nav stations in the standard design.

IbexMother.description: This reactor powered long range survey and exploration vessel can house a small crew in relative comfort. Includes two adjacent air tight bays rated for science and engineering. Given the potentially volatile nature of the experiments done on the Ibex, the ship has additional redundancy in the form of two Nav stations in the standard design.

Inspection Pod.description: A small craft designed for close inspection work of stations and larger ships. Seats one, and not comfortably.

Katydid.description: One of the smallest possible spacecraft with an airlock and environmental system, the Katydid is built with MSS parts to cut down even further on weight. The final design was made even smaller when a clever engineer realized that the life support and RCS intake regulator could share a single O2 canister.

LB-77a.description: Nicknamed the "cattle car," the LB-77a is designed to ferry EVA suited workers to job sites in local space as cheaply as possible. In the OKLG Boneyard it's not unusual to see dozens of spacers packed onto the vessel, clinging to cargo webbing, half of them mooing as a joke.

Li Bai Gen II Refit.description: One of the largest mass-manufactured luxury pleasure yachts, the Li Bai was built by Van Hummel under contract from the hospitality corporation Renske International. The ship is used primarily by the uber-wealthy in the Martian system, especially those being ferried between the planet and its orbitals. Divided starkly between crew and client quarters, the ship sleeps nine comfortably and comes standard with a full cherrywood bar.

Light Tug.description: A small salvage ship designed for pushing ships and cargo pods around in local space. Comes standard with a tow brace. Packed with additional RCS thrusters and a spiral of intake regulators to create greater thrust than other similar sized tugs.

Local Ferry.description: A small passenger ferry that seats half a dozen and is used for short duration travel. Lacks major amenities beyond barebones environmental management. Includes a toilet but you probably don't want to use it...

Medium Ferry.description: An extremely large, reactor-powered passenger ferry that seats over a dozen.  Designed for medium range travel given the lack of cabins, but is often retrofitted for longer hauls. A spacer superstition dictates that passengers are to tip two yuan to a Charon pilot after a successful journey.

Mesa.description: Perhaps the most iconic freighter in the early Testudo line, the Mesa is essentially eight big boxes and a long corridor. The initial production run began in 2041 but lasted well into the late 2050s. While not produced in the same volume as the Edelweiss due to issues with assembly facilities, the Mesa is widely regarded as the first true freighter of the colony rush.

MesaCargo.description: Perhaps the most iconic freighter in the early Testudo line, the Mesa is essentially eight big boxes and a long corridor. The initial production run began in 2041 but lasted well into the late 2050s. While not produced in the same volume as the Edelweiss due to issues with assembly facilities, the Mesa is widely regarded as the first true freighter of the colony rush.

MonoCarrier.description: This reactor powered long range survey and exploration vessel can house a small crew in relative comfort. Includes two adjacent air tight bays rated for science and engineering. Given the potentially volatile nature of the experiments done on the Ibex, the ship has additional redundancy in the form of two Nav stations in the standard design.

Myna.description: A reactor-powered, cabinless courier with a minimal RCS package. Originally developed as an extended-range military interceptor, the Myna's weapons were stripped after the contract fell through late into negotiations. The housings left behind from the weapons were unceremoniously converted into a bathroom.

Ocelot.description: A large, cylindrical, reactor-powered freighter that comes standard with two D2O tanks. The Ocelot gained minor notoriety in 2078 when an unskilled pilot dragged one across the surface of 1036 Ganymed after miscalculating a simple maneuver. Now folks say the ship only has eight lives left.

Ostrich A4R.description: The Ostrich is a cargo ship with 4 cargo pods, designed for efficient atmospheric transport

Ostrich A8R.description: The Ostrich is a cargo ship with 8 cargo pods, designed for efficient atmospheric transport

Pequod Pirate Refit.description: A combat retrofit of the well-known luxury freighter, the Pequod, using low-end weapons. Less effective in a fight than dedicated combat ships, they still see regular use in theaters where mainline navies lack a presence.

Pequod Titan Refit.description: A combat retrofit of the well-known luxury freighter, the Pequod, using US military tech. Less effective in a fight than dedicated combat ships, they still see regular use in theaters where mainline navies lack a presence.

Pequod Xinhua Refit.description: A combat retrofit of the well-known luxury freighter, the Pequod, using Xinhua military tech. Less effective in a fight than dedicated combat ships, they still see regular use in theaters where mainline navies lack a presence.

Pequod2.description: One of the only luxury freighters in existence, the Pequod is used primarily as a showfloor for the kind of uber-wealthy client who insists on seeing their cargo loaded and unloaded personally. Reactor powered, sleeps two with room for more if the cargo bays are retrofitted for crew.

Port Mojave Resupply.description: A Testudo-manufactured, standard-sized shipping container often stacked on super large cargo liners. Intermodals are often shunted off by small tugs on ballistic trajectories across The System, with the expectation of being caught at their destination by a second tugboat. It means a single small set of tugs can move thousands of tonnes more cargo than a freighter, but the delivery time is in the region of weeks to months rather than hours to days.

Port Mojave Roof Xin.description: Surface buildings from when Port Mojave was established, built around the mouth of the main excavation shaft.

Port Mojave Roof.description: Surface buildings from when Port Mojave was established, built around the mouth of the main excavation shaft.

Port Mojave Xin.description: Main docking and services facility for Port Mojave.

Port Mojave.description: Main docking and services facility for Port Mojave.

Primigenial PY.description: An extremely fast, lightweight RCS ship with a design and interior layout inspired by Earther sailing vessels. Boasts double Miura Hydra Intake Regulators and an RCS package with two dozen thrusters. A favorite among the elite Martian hobbyist class in West Lake, the Primigenial is nicknamed the "Hangzhou Hangman" because of how many amateur pilots it kills every year.

Pugongying.description: A missile cruiser deployed by the Xinhua Navy. They are typically escorted by other ships, owing to their lack of direct-fire weapons.

RF-72m.description: A product of executive meddling. The RF-72m was initially designed as a large, longer duration construction vessel, able to house work crews for weeks on end. The introduction of the Testudo Mesa during its development pushed Ryokka into contracting Mobile Space Systems to upgrade its cargo capacity with the addition of four large, flimsy external cargo units to market the ship as a freighter. The move was a costly failure, producing a delicate, overpriced and resource-hungry vessel.

Rouncy.description: A smallish reactor-powered all purpose vessel perfect for a solo spacer. Comes standard with two Miura "Hydra" Intake Regulators. One of Testudo's most popular designs. Often compared favorably to the Myna, another Testudo design.

Royal Flush.description: One of the rare small ships manufactured by luxury builder Van Hummel, the Royal Flush is used to shuttle VIP passengers between one expensive location and another. The ship lacks a reactor but is extremely nimble on RCS, boasting two wings with six thrusters each and a Miura intake regulator.

SCI Retrofit.description: A standard cargo container retrofitted with the bare minimum kit necessary to navigate from one point in space to another. An EVA suit is recommended in the event the origin or destination lacks air, or the trip is longer than 15 minutes. Basically a death trap. But cheap!

SCI.description: A Testudo-manufactured, standard-sized shipping container often stacked on super large cargo liners. Intermodals are often shunted off by small tugs on ballistic trajectories across The System, with the expectation of being caught at their destination by a second tugboat. It means a single small set of tugs can move thousands of tonnes more cargo than a freighter, but the delivery time is in the region of weeks to months rather than hours to days.

SalvageCustom.description: A hodgepodge of smuggled parts hastily welded together and exposed to hard vacuum. Nearly impossible to pilot without an EVA suit. A ship only a mother could love.

SalvageCustom2.description: A hodgepodge of smuggled parts hastily welded together with only a single room equipped for safe travel. The exposed center deck between the airlock and cabin make piloting this ship without a pressure suit nearly impossible. Hard to even call a fixer-upper.

SalvagePod.description: One of a series of small salvage ships built by Ryokka on contract with Ayotimiwa. Vessels in the Ryokka TU line are ubiquitous and sought after in the OKLG Boneyard given their efficiency for solo spacers and relatively favorable mortgage rates. It's rumored that the corporation has dozens more factory fresh TU models mothballed in a secret hangar as a strategy to create artificial scarcity.

SalvagePodEndurance.description: A salvage pod with bed and wash facilities built for longer duration salvage jobs. Had limited success given that the TU-77a was released shortly after this design. Comes standard with four large batteries.

SalvagePodEnduranceTut.description: A salvage pod with bed and wash facilities built for longer duration salvage jobs. Had limited success given that the TU-77a was released shortly after this design. Comes standard with four large batteries.

SalvagePodSmall.description: One of a series of small tugs built by Ryokka on contract with Ayotimiwa. Vessels in the Ryokka TU line are ubiquitous and sought after in the OKLG Boneyard given their efficiency for solo spacers and relatively favorable mortgage rates. It's rumored that the corporation has dozens more factory fresh TU models mothballed in a secret hangar as a strategy to create artificial scarcity.

SalvagePodTest.description: A relic from 2038, the Lilliput was built by Testudo before the colony rush as a ferry between the Earth-side space elevators and shuttles to Luna. It would look more at home in a museum than in flight. It's very possible this ship was put into consumer circulation by mistake.

SalvagePodTestTut.description: A relic from 2038, the Lilliput was built by Testudo before the colony rush as a ferry between the Earth-side space elevators and Luna. It would look more at home in a museum than in flight. It's very possible this ship was put into consumer circulation by mistake.

ShuttleSmall.description: A small shuttlecraft designed for ferrying between structures and ships in local space. Built to accommodate either a small cabin, quad jump seats, or cargo space, depending on the model.

ShuttleSmallCargo.description: A small shuttlecraft designed for ferrying between structures and ships in local space. Built to accommodate either a small cabin, quad jump seats, or cargo space, depending on the model.

ShuttleSmallSleeper.description: A small shuttlecraft designed for ferrying between structures and ships in local space. Built to accommodate either a small cabin, quad jump seats, or cargo space, depending on the model.

ShuttleSmallTut.description: A small shuttlecraft designed for ferrying between structures and ships in local space. Built to accommodate either a small cabin, quad jump seats, or cargo space, depending on the model.

Squall.description: A medium-sized shuttle developed by Testudo for limited operations around the Aerostats of Venus.

Station Tug.description: A custom racer scratch built for illegal RCS circuit rallies. Maximized for speed and maneuverability, so all systems not relevant to these ends have been cut, including life-support. About as safe as the name implies.

Station_JFTS.description: The primary spaceport on Ganymede, located in Ganymede City.

Station_VCBR.description: Science aerostat owned and run by a contract research organisation of the same name researching the Venusian surface.

Sundancer XR.description: Based on the Sundancer platform, the XR edition includes an RCS maneuvering system to enable limited travel outside the atmosphere.

Sundancer.description: Little more than an enclosed pilot seat and some rotors, this commuter craft represents the barest minimum of air transport. Its size, appearance, and relative ubiquity has earned it the more common moniker of "Mosquito" among locals.

TankerPod D2O.description: One of a series of small tugs built by Ryokka on contract with Ayotimiwa, the 66a hauls deuterium. Vessels in the Ryokka TU line are ubiquitous and sought after in the OKLG Boneyard given their efficiency for solo spacers and relatively favorable mortgage rates. It's rumored that the corporation has dozens more factory fresh TU models mothballed in a secret hangar as a strategy to create artificial scarcity.

TankerPod Unmarked.description: One of a series of small tugs built by Ryokka on contract with Ayotimiwa, the 1a is not specialised for any one fluid. Vessels in the Ryokka TU line are ubiquitous and sought after in the OKLG Boneyard given their efficiency for solo spacers and relatively favorable mortgage rates. It's rumored that the corporation has dozens more factory fresh TU models mothballed in a secret hangar as a strategy to create artificial scarcity.

Tombolo 2.description: Despite being manufactured in 2046, the Tombolo Mk. II freighter remains one of the most popular ships in the System. Powered by a fusion reactor and outfitted with four independently pressurized cargo bays with optional external webbing, the Tombolo is about the largest ship an experienced captain could hope to operate comfortably while flying solo.

Tombolo.description: Despite being manufactured in 2046, the Tombolo Mk. II freighter remains one of the most popular ships in the System. Powered by a fusion reactor and outfitted with four independently pressurized cargo bays with optional external webbing, the Tombolo is about the largest ship an experienced captain could hope to operate comfortably while flying solo.

Tricorn.description: A small, personal craft designed for atmospheric and limited SSTO operations. The unconventional third rotor gives it a surprising amount of power, and uses specially-tuned timings to counterbalance against angular momentum.

Tutorial Light Ferry.description: A small passenger ferry that seats half a dozen and is used for short duration travel. Lacks major amenities beyond barebones environmental management.

UtilityPod.description: The Testudo Melody shares some similarities with the Ryokka TU-77a salvage pod, but with batteries, canisters, intake regulators and RCS thrusters all on the outside. It's a more capable ship than the ubiquitous Ryokka model, but more difficult to maintain, especially without an EVA suit.

UtilityPodTut.description: The Testudo Melody shares some similarities with the Ryokka TU-77a salvage pod, but with batteries, canisters, intake regulators and RCS thrusters all on the outside. It's a more capable ship than the ubiquitous Ryokka model, but more difficult to maintain, especially without an EVA suit.

Vector2.description: A standard law enforcement cruiser. Sluggish but durable. Comes standard with a coffee machine, but no donuts.

Vector3 Pirate Refit.description: A technical/interceptor built on the chassis of a Vector Mk. III, found in wide use among naval fleets.

Vector3 Titan Refit.description: A technical/interceptor built on the chassis of a Vector Mk. III, found in wide use among naval fleets.

Vector3 Xinhua Refit.description: A high speed variant of the standard law enforcement vessel, designed to address complaints from law enforcement personnel about the Mark II's limited ability to steamroll targets.

Vector3.description: A high speed variant of the standard law enforcement vessel, designed to address complaints from law enforcement personnel about the Mark II's limited ability to steamroll targets.

Volatile Aero.description: A surprisingly common retrofit of a popular space hot rod, adapted for atmospheric flight.

Volatile Prize Ship.description: Hot rod RCS racer with a huge bank of external thruster packages. Capable of extremely high speeds, outrunning even intelligence.

Whistler Hot-Rod.description: A custom, high-end RCS racer with coveted "orange way" interiors. Not much room, but plenty of vroom.

_MiningCombatTest.description: An up-gunned variant of one of Testudo's most popular designs, the Rouncy. Often used as a stand-in naval vessel for extranational fleets.

_fighttest.description: An experimental mobile railgun platform, modified by Brave New World with an excessive complement of mass drivers, and related equipment, to stress test power systems and other dynamics.

ResBCRS01.description: A modular, pressurized unit leased from the CCRE for housing residential and commercial activities on Ring Station.

ResBCRS02.description: A first generation Ring Station axial module for lease from CCRE for housing and commercial activities.

ResMSUZ01.description: A modular, pressurized station unit leased for residential and commercial activities.

ResMSUZ02.description: A standardized station module on leased for housing and commercial activities.
